ov: Small bony fish, 47 species, named for their horse-like head and neck. The male carries the eggs in a brood pouch on his front until the young are ready to be born.

why.et: Dried seahorses are widely used in traditional Chinese medicine, despite no clinical evidence that they work.
why.p: Kept by aquarium hobbyists, though wild-caught seahorses tend to do poorly in home tanks.

df: Small shrimps and other tiny prey.
fx: A female can deposit up to 1,500 eggs in the male’s pouch, and he carries them for 9–45 days.
